issues.title: Display Default Message Content on Notification create page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager,
* **I want to** see the "Default" message content when selected,
* **so that** I know what message will be sent to recipients of the notification.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

* **Given** a Notification Manager is on the "Send Notification" page,
* **And** "Response Required" is set to "Yes",
* **When** the "Message" dropdown is set to "Default",
* **Then** a read-only view of the default message **must** appear below the dropdown,
* **And** the editable field used for "Custom" message **must not** be visible,
* **And** when the "Confirm Notification" button is clicked, the default message is sent in the notification.

issues.title: Display default responses on Notification create page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager,
* **I want to** see the "Default" response options when selected,
* **so that** I know what responses will be available to recipients of the message I am sending.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

* **Given** a Notification Manager is on the "Send Notification" page,
* **And** "Response Required" is set to "Yes",
* **When** the "Response" dropdown is set to "Default",
* **Then** a read-only view of the default response options (e.g., a list of the response buttons/choices) **must** appear below the dropdown,
* **And** the editable fields used for "Custom" responses **must not** be visible,
* **And** when the "Confirm Notification" button is clicked, the default options are used for responses.

issues.title: Conditionally Display Email Help Text
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager,
* **I want** the help text for email notifications to appear only when I select the "Email" checkbox,
* **so that** the interface is cleaner and I only see information relevant to the channels I've actually chosen.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: Initial Page Load**

* **Given** a Notification Manager is on the "Send Notification" page,
* **And** the "Email" checkbox is unchecked by default,
* **When** the page finishes loading,
* **Then** the help text related to email notifications **must not** be visible.

**Scenario 2: User Selects the Email Option**

* **Given** the email-related help text is not visible,
* **When** the user clicks the "Email" checkbox to select it,
* **Then** the email-related help text **must** immediately appear on the page, positioned logically near the email selection area.

**Scenario 3: User De-selects the Email Option**

* **Given** the "Email" checkbox is checked and the help text is visible,
* **When** the user clicks the "Email" checkbox again to uncheck it,
* **Then** the email-related help text **must** immediately disappear.

issues.title: Expand Layer Selection for Notification Managers
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager for a specific layer,
* **I want to** be able to select my assigned layer and all of its sub-layers as notification recipients,
* **so that** I can communicate effectively with the entire hierarchy under my responsibility, not just my immediate layer.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: Viewing the Recipient Selection UI**

* **Given** I am logged in as a Notification Manager assigned specifically to "Layer 2",
* **When** I navigate to the "Send Notification" page,
* **And** I select "Organization Layer" in the "To:" field,
* **Then** the recipient selection tool **must** display my assigned layer ("Layer 2")
* **And** it **must** also display all sub-layers beneath my assigned layer (e.g., "Layer 2.1", "Layer 2.2", "Layer 2.2.1").
* **And** it **must not** display any layers that are above my assigned layer (e.g., "Layer 1").
* **And** it **must not** display any layers that are parallel to my assigned layer (e.g., "Layer 3").

**Scenario 2: Sending a Notification to a Sub-Layer**

* **Given** I am a Notification Manager for "Layer 2",
* **And** I am on the "Send Notification" page,
* **When** I select only a sub-layer ("Layer 2.1") as a recipient and send the notification,
* **Then** only users assigned to "Layer 2.1" **must** receive the notification.

**Scenario 3: Sending a Notification to Multiple Layers (Parent and Sub-Layer)**

* **Given** I am a Notification Manager for "Layer 2",
* **And** I am on the "Send Notification" page,
* **When** I select my own layer ("Layer 2") AND a sub-layer ("Layer 2.2") as recipients and send the notification,
* **Then** users in both "Layer 2" and "Layer 2.2" **must** receive the notification.

**Scenario 4: Regression Test for Organization-level Manager**

* **Given** I am logged in as a Notification Manager for the entire organization (no layer restriction),
* **When** I navigate to the "Send Notification" page,
* **Then** the recipient selection tool **must** display all layers within the entire organization.

issues.title: Improve Organization Field Instructional Text
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** new user registering for ORBIT,
* **I want** the instructional note for selecting my Organization to be clearer and placed directly under the field it refers to,
* **so that** I can immediately understand the correct action to take if I cannot find my specific organization in the list.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario: User Views the Registration Page**

* **Given** a new user is on the self-registration page,
* **When** the page renders,
* **Then** the note text "**_Note:_** Select the Organization to which you are assigned. If your organization is not listed, please contact your supervisor." **must** be displayed.
* **And** this note **must** be positioned directly below the "Organization" selection field and above the "Sub-organization" selection field.
* **And** the old text ("**_Note:_** Only register for your Organization...") **must not** be visible anywhere on the page.

issues.title: Add Instructional Text for Sub-Organization Field
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** new user registering for ORBIT,
* **I want to** see a clear note explaining that the Sub-Organization field is optional,
* **so that** I can confidently complete my registration without getting stuck if I don't know my specific Sub-Organization.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario: User Views the Registration Page**

* **Given** a new user is on the self-registration page,
* **When** the page renders,
* **Then** the note text "**_Note:_** If you know the Sub-Organization to which you are assigned, you can enter it here. If you do not know, you can leave this field blank." **must** be displayed.
* **And** this note **must** be positioned directly below the "Sub-organization" selection field.

issues.title: Unify Profile View with Edit Mode
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** ORBIT user,
* **I want to** see all of my profile information sections when I view my profile, in the same order that they appear in edit mode,
* **so that** I can easily and completely review my data for accuracy without having to enter the edit screen.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: User Views Their Profile**

* **Given** a user is on their "View Profile" page,
* **When** the page finishes loading,
* **Then** it **must** display sections for "Mobile Check-In Information" and "Notification Information".
* **And** all sections on the page **must** be arranged in the following specific order:
  1. General Information
  2. Work Contact Information
  3. Contractor Information
  4. Home Address Information
  5. Emergency Contact Information
  6. Mobile Check-In Information
  7. Notification Information

**Scenario 2: Verifying Data Display**

* **Given** a user has entered and saved specific data in the "Mobile Check-In Information" and "Notification Information" sections via the "Edit Profile" page,
* **When** they navigate to the "View Profile" page,
* **Then** the saved data for those sections **must** be correctly displayed.

---

#### **Test Cases**

| Test ID | Description | Steps | Expected Result |
|---------|-------------|-------|-----------------|
| **TC-001** | **UI - Section Presence:** Verify the two missing sections now appear in view mode. | 1\. Navigate to the "View Profile" page. | A section titled "Mobile Check-In Information" and a section titled "Notification Information" are both visible. |
| **TC-002** | **UI - Section Order:** Verify the order of all sections is correct in view mode. | 1\. Navigate to the "View Profile" page. 2. Observe the order of all information sections from top to bottom. | The sections appear in the exact order specified in the Acceptance Criteria. |
| **TC-003** | **Data Integrity Test:** Verify data from the new sections is displayed correctly. | 1\. Go to "Edit Profile". 2. Enter unique, identifiable data into fields within "Mobile Check-In Information" and "Notification Information". 3. Save the changes. 4. Go to "View Profile". | The unique data entered in step 2 is displayed correctly in the corresponding sections on the view page. |
| **TC-004** | **Regression Test:** Verify that existing sections still display data correctly. | 1\. Navigate to "View Profile". 2. Check the data displayed in the "General Information" and "Work Contact Information" sections. | The data in the previously existing sections is still present and accurate. |

issues.title: Restructure Emergency Contact Information Section (UI Only)
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** ORBIT user viewing or editing my profile,
* **I want** the emergency contact fields to be organized into two distinct sub-sections, "Emergency Contact 1" and "Emergency Contact 2",
* **so that** I can more easily distinguish between my primary and secondary contacts and review their information at a glance.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: Viewing or Editing the Profile Layout**

* **Given** a user is on their "View Profile" or "Edit Profile" page,
* **When** the "Emergency Contact Information" section is rendered,
* **Then** it **must** be visually divided into two sub-sections, clearly titled "Emergency Contact 1" and "Emergency Contact 2".
* **And** each sub-section **must** contain exactly three fields, labeled "Name", "Phone Number", and "Relationship".
* **And** the old, flat list of six individual fields **must** no longer be visible.

**Scenario 2: Verifying Correct Data Binding**

* **Given** a user has existing data for their primary and secondary emergency contacts,
* **When** the "Edit Profile" or "View Profile" page loads,
* **Then** the data corresponding to "Emergency Contact 1" **must** correctly populate the fields within the "Emergency Contact 1" sub-section.
* **And** the data corresponding to "Emergency Contact 2" **must** correctly populate the fields within the "Emergency Contact 2" sub-section.

---

#### **Test Cases**

| Test ID | Description | Steps | Expected Result |
|---------|-------------|-------|-----------------|
| **TC-001** | **UI - Layout Verification:** Confirm the new structure is in place on both View and Edit pages. | 1\. Navigate to the "View Profile" page. 2. Navigate to the "Edit Profile" page. | Both pages display the Emergency Contact section with two sub-sections, "Emergency Contact 1" and "Emergency Contact 2", each containing "Name", "Phone Number", and "Relationship" fields. |
| **TC-002** | **UI - Regression:** Confirm the old UI elements are removed. | 1\. Navigate to the "View Profile" page. 2. Navigate to the "Edit Profile" page. | The old layout (a flat list of six fields like "EMERGENCY CONTACT NAME", "EMERGENCY CONTACT PHONE", etc.) is no longer present on either page. |
| **TC-003** | **Data Binding Test:** Verify that existing data is displayed in the correct new fields. | 1\. Using a test user with pre-populated data for both emergency contacts, navigate to the "View Profile" page. | The name for contact 1 appears in the "Name" field under "Emergency Contact 1". The phone for contact 2 appears in the "Phone Number" field under "Emergency Contact 2", and so on. |
| **TC-004** | **Empty State Test:** Verify the layout renders correctly for users with no emergency contact data. | 1\. Using a profile with no emergency contact info, navigate to the "View Profile" and "Edit Profile" pages. | The two sub-sections and their respective fields are displayed correctly as empty, and the page functions without errors. |

issues.title: Add Unsaved Changes Confirmation on Cancel on Edit Profile
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** ORBIT user editing my profile,
* **I want to** be prompted with a confirmation dialog if I click "Cancel" after I've made changes,
* **so that** I can avoid accidentally discarding my updates without saving.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: User Cancels With NO Unsaved Changes**

* **Given** a user is on the "Edit Profile" page,
* **And** they have not made any changes to the form fields,
* **When** they click the "Cancel" button,
* **Then** they **must** be immediately redirected to the "View Profile" page without any confirmation prompt.

**Scenario 2: User Cancels WITH Unsaved Changes**

* **Given** a user is on the "Edit Profile" page,
* **And** they have made at least one change to a form field,
* **When** they click the "Cancel" button,
* **Then** a confirmation dialog **must** appear.
* **And** the dialog **must** contain text similar to: "You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?"
* **And** the dialog **must** have two options, such as "Discard Changes" and "Continue Editing".

**Scenario 3: User Confirms to Discard Changes**

* **Given** the "unsaved changes" confirmation dialog is displayed,
* **When** the user clicks the "Discard Changes" button,
* **Then** the dialog **must** close.
* **And** the user **must** be redirected to the "View Profile" page.
* **And** the changes they made **must not** be saved.

**Scenario 4: User Chooses to Continue Editing**

* **Given** the "unsaved changes" confirmation dialog is displayed,
* **When** the user clicks the "Continue Editing" button,
* **Then** the dialog **must** close.
* **And** the user **must** remain on the "Edit Profile" page.
* **And** the unsaved changes they made **must** still be visible in the form fields.

---

#### **Test Cases**

| Test ID | Description | Steps | Expected Result |
|---------|-------------|-------|-----------------|
| **TC-001** | **Happy Path (No Changes):** Verify no prompt appears if no edits are made. | 1\. Navigate to "Edit Profile". 2. Immediately click "Cancel". | The user is redirected to the "View Profile" page without any confirmation dialog. |
| **TC-002** | **Modal Trigger:** Verify the prompt appears after an edit. | 1\. Navigate to "Edit Profile". 2. Type a character into any text field. 3. Click "Cancel". | The confirmation dialog appears. |
| **TC-003** | **Confirm Discard:** Verify changes are discarded after confirming cancellation. | 1\. Perform steps for TC-002. 2. Click "Discard Changes" in the dialog. 3. Once on the "View Profile" page, click "Edit" again. | The user is redirected, and upon returning to the edit page, the field is back to its original value (the change was not saved). |
| **TC-004** | **Deny Cancel:** Verify the user stays on the page after denying cancellation. | 1\. Perform steps for TC-002. 2. Click "Continue Editing" in the dialog. | The dialog closes, the user remains on the "Edit Profile" page, and the character typed in step 2 is still visible in the field. |
| **TC-005** | **UI/Text Verification:** Verify the text on the confirmation dialog. | 1\. Trigger the confirmation dialog. | The text is clear, grammatically correct, and accurately reflects the choice the user needs to make. |

issues.title: Display Message Content on "Confirm Notification" page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager viewing the Confirm Notification page for a notification I am preparing to send,
* **I want to** see the message that will be sent to recipients,
* **so that** I can confirm that the message is correct before I send the notification.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1**

* **Given** a Notification Manager has "Email" as the "Channel" on the Notification creation page, 
* **And** is on the "Confirm Notification" page,
* **Then** a section displaying the content of the email message **must** appear on the page and clearly indicate that the message will be delivered via email.

**Scenario 2**

* **Given** a Notification Manager has selected only "Text Message" as the "Channel" on the Notification creation page, 
* **And** is on the "Confirm Notification" page,
* **Then** a section displaying the content of the text message **must** appear on the page and clearly indicate that the message will be delivered via text message.

**Scenario 3**

* **Given** a Notification Manager has selected both "Email" and "Text Message" as the "Channel" on the Notification creation page, 
* **And** is on the "Confirm Notification" page,
* **Then** a section displaying the content of the email message **must** appear on the page and clearly indicate that the message will be delivered via email.
* **And** a section displaying the content of the text message **must** appear on the page and clearly indicate that the message will be delivered via text message.

issues.title: Display response options on "Confirm Notification" page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** Notification Manager viewing the Confirm Notification page for a notification I am preparing to send,
* **I want to** see the response options I have configured,
* **so that** I can confirm that the response options are configured correctly before I send the notification.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

* **Given** a Notification Manager has configured responses on the "Notification" creation page 
* **And** is on the "Confirm Notification" page,
* **Then** a section displaying the configured response options **must** appear on the page.
